perks.name: Genesis
perks.ddcText: Energy Weapons generate 1 Ammo against Matching Combatant Elemental Shields per hit. Upon breaking a Combatant , Barrier , or Guardian Shield: Refills magazine. ↑Passively grants +5 Handling.
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.ddcText: On Elemental , Barrier or Guardian Shield Break : Inflicts Kinetic Damage Vulnerability on the enemy, increasing Kinetic Damage Taken b y 50% for 5.5 ↑? [5] seconds. Does not affect Stasis or Strand Damage. Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself). Can be applied multiple times on a single enemy, with each stack having its own duration and stacking multiplicatively.
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.ddcText: On Matching Combatant Elemental Shield Break : Enemies within 7 metres become disoriented for 5 seconds
perks.description: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

perks.name: Energy Transfer
perks.ddcText: While Guarding with a Sword : Every point of damage taken grants Class Ability Energy . 1.5% ↑1.55% Class Ability Energy when Melee Damage is blocked. 1% ↑1.25% Class Ability Energy when Non-Melee Damage is blocked. 0.5% ↑0.625% Class Ability Energy when receiving Non-Blocked damage.
perks.description: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.ddcText: On Weapon Kill : Target explodes, dealing up to 30 Solar Damage and inflicting x30 +10 ↑+15 Scorch over 4 meters. Elite+ Combatants and Guardians trigger a stronger explosion that inflicts x40 +10 ↑x45 +15 Scorch over 8 meters. Damage from the Scorching Explosion and Scorch can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs and Debuffs and are unaffected by Combatant Rank Multipliers . ↑Increases the number of Scorch Stacks applied.
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.ddcText: Upon damaging a Non-Matching Shield or a Barrier Champion Shield : Stacking damage increase against Combatant Shields . Buff is removed upon hitting a Matching Shield or an Unshielded Combatant . ???% ↑???% per hit, up to ???% ↑???% : Fusion Rifles . 10% ↑14% per hit, up to 50% ↑69.5% : Auto Rifles, Machine Guns , Pulse Rifles, and Trace Rifles . 22% ↑31% per hit, up to 44.5% ↑61.5% : Linear Fusion Rifles . 25% ↑34.5% per hit, up to 50% ↑69.5% : Bows, Glaives , Hand Cannons, and Scout Rifles.
perks.description: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.ddcText: Upon shattering a crystal or killing a Frozen Enemy : Grants 1 ↑2 stacks of Frost Armor . Can also trigger with Glaive Melee .
perks.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.ddcText: On Weapon Kill : Grants Crystalline Corpsebloom for 4 seconds. While Crystalline Corpsebloom is active : Weapon Kills cause the enemy to release a Stasis Seeker on death. Stasis Seeker travels 3? meters in a random direction, spawning a Medium? ↑Large Stasis Crystal upon expiring.
perks.description: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.ddcText: Upon scoring a hit on a Special or Heavy Ammo Brick : Picks up Ammo and refills all equipped weapons. Triggers Ammo Pickup effects. Only activates if picking up ammo is possible by not having full Ammo. Can also pick up Orbs of Power without any additional effect. Splash Damage can also trigger Shoot To Loot. ↑Passively grants +5 Range.
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Redirection
perks.ddcText: Upon scoring a hit against Rank-And-File Combatants : Grants 2 stacks of Redirection, up to a maximum of 30 stacks. Stacks persist through stow. Upon scoring a hit against an Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Vehicle : Consumes up to 3 ↑2 stacks, granting 33% ↑50% increased damage per stack, up to 100% at 3 ↑2 stacks. Stacks are consumed even on Immune Hits.
perks.description: Damaging rank-and-file combatants increases damage against more powerful ones.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.ddcText: Upon scoring a hit with 12 ↑10 pellets : Shotgun: 150% [100%] | Hand Cannon: 75% [50%] increased Melee Damage for the next Melee Hit within 3 seconds. Buff is removed on stow. One-Two Punch does not stack with the passive Melee Damage Increase against Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence. ↑Pellet Activation Requirement is decreased from 12 to 10.
perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

localPolicies.shields: No combatant shield element existed. CombatantShields: entity tag destiny_shield_<arc|solar|void|stasis|strand> or destiny_shield_barrier wins; Fallen and Devils' Lair Captains/other absorption-shield mobs default Arc, Devils' Lair Wizards Solar. Other vanilla absorption is not a combatant shield. Guardian (PvP) shields are not modelled.
localPolicies.rank: CombatantRank: Guardian; tags destiny_boss/destiny_vehicle/destiny_miniboss/destiny_elite; Wither/Ender Dragon boss; Devils Walker/Sepiks boss, Brig miniboss, Captain/Knight/Wizard/Servitor elite; shielded mobs elite; other mobs rank-and-file.
localPolicies.adaptiveMunitions: Fusion Rifle row is ???; no fusion roll exists in this pool, fallback uses the Auto Rifle row. Barrier (elementless) shields count as non-matching.
localPolicies.disruptionBreak: Applied in the weapon damage path to Kinetic-element weapon damage only (any shooter). Kinetic ability damage is not boosted.
localPolicies.shieldDisorient: Disorient maps to the existing BLINDED keyword (target loss + slowness).
localPolicies.genesis: Energy weapon = ENERGY slot. +1 loaded round per matching shield hit; break refills the magazine from reserves on the next server tick.
localPolicies.energyTransfer: Per Destiny point: Minecraft loss converted by 230/maxHealth; blocked hits are un-scaled by the 5% guard factor. Melee = direct mob attack without projectile. Capped at a full class ability per event.
localPolicies.incandescent: 30 points converted by 230/maxHealth of a Guardian (20 HP) => ~2.6 HP. Scorch stacks map to 2 ticks of the existing scorch status per stack. Elite explosion damage is unspecified (?), reuses 30.
localPolicies.redirection: 33% per stack; three stacks are clamped to the DDC 100% cap. Consumption happens before immunity checks.
localPolicies.oneTwoPunch: Requirement = min(12, weapon pellets) pellets of one shot on one target. Buff is consumed by the next accepted powered melee.
localPolicies.crystals: No Stasis existed. Medium crystal: freezes enemies within 2.5 blocks on formation for 3 s, 10 s lifetime, shatters on any player's hitscan ray/blast/weapon hit within reach, 4 HP Kinetic damage within 3 blocks. Seeker = 0.75 s delayed spawn 3 blocks in a random horizontal direction.
localPolicies.frostArmor: DDC Weapon Perks tab has no Frost Armor value: 5% damage resistance per stack, 5 stacks, 10 s refresh on gain.
localPolicies.shootToLoot: Orbs of Power do not exist in this project; only Special/Heavy personal ammo bricks crossed by a hitscan pellet ray are collected. Equipped weapons refill from reserves on the next server tick.
localPolicies.pulseMonitorAlias: 205890336 rolls are the same logical pulse_monitor trait. Existing 972757866 selections stay valid. Alias-only weapons without a pinned W200 handling curve receive only the 0.95 ready/stow scalar.
